meta.title: Pehla Startup Fail, Doosra $1.4 Billion Ka: Zepto Story
meta.fullVoiceover: Pehla startup fail hua. Lagbhag do saal baad doosra $1.4 billion ka! Kaise? 2020 me 17-18 saal ke Aadit aur Kaivalya ne KiranaKart banaya. Wo chala nahi. Par ruke nahi. 2021 me 10 minute delivery ka idea leke Zepto banaya. Jan 2021 me valuation $2.5 million thi. August 2023 me $1.4 billion! Twist: reports ke mutabik Zepto ne IPO ab aage badha diya hai. Pro tip: fail hona end nahi, seekhne ka data hai. Tumhari sabse badi failure? Comment karo, aur follow karo @techwith.GenZ.
meta.instagramCaption:
🤯 Pehla startup fail hua. Lagbhag do saal baad doosra $1.4 billion ka ban gaya. Kaise? Zepto ki kahani 👇

💥 2020: Aadit Palicha aur Kaivalya Vohra (17-18 saal) ne KiranaKart banaya, par wo chala nahi
🚀 2021: 10 minute delivery ke idea ke saath Zepto banaya
📈 Jan 2021: valuation ~$2.5 million
🦄 Aug 2023: $200M funding, valuation $1.4 billion (unicorn!)
⏳ Twist: reports ke mutabik Zepto ne apna IPO aage badha diya hai. Unicorn banna ek baat hai, tikna doosri.

💡 Pro tip: fail hona end nahi, seekhne ka data hai. Pehle idea se seekho, phir pivot karo.

Aapki sabse badi failure ne aapko kya sikhaya? Comment me batao 👇
Aur ye reel us dost ko bhejo jo fail hone se darta hai 🔥

Follow @techwith.GenZ for daily tech aur startup stories.

⚠️ Disclaimer: Ye sirf educational aur motivational content hai, investment advice nahi. Numbers public reports par based hain.
